verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API is documented as reading account information and balances from a user's connected bank through a single interface, so a connected-account balance read exists. The evidence does not show it is real-time, positioned for pre-payment NSF or risk checks, or tied into the Payments API flow. Merchant account balances in Console are a different feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time balance freshness, documented NSF/risk-check use case, pre-payment integration guidance, endpoint-level reference detail, independent corroboration.
